about: The introitus of the formulary “16th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to You all day long; for You, O Lord, are sweet and gentle, and rich in mercy to all who call upon You. Incline Your ear to me, O Lord, and hear me, for I am needy and poor. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
